title: taM5CZTyping
summary: Type, improve, and compete in a 30-second English typing challenge.
description: Type short English or programming words in 30-second, 60-second or untimed ten-word rounds. Live WPM, accuracy, strict letter matching, automatic word advancement, miss counts and local personal bests. Optional English-only 30-second online challenges share your player name and server-verified score on public leaderboards. Offline play does not connect. A mascot inspired by the official M5Stack StackChan K151 accompanies your rounds. Optional private contact email can be managed on your phone using a short-lived QR code. This is an independent community app, not an official M5Stack application. Contact email is optional, private, unverified, and used only by the organizer for event result notifications; no automatic emails are sent.
